content.text: There are three unresolved threads, and they collapse into two fixes: keep task metadata aligned when missing sessions shift indices, and make `--force` truly remove stale v2 session data before re-migrating. I’ll read the migration path and tests, then patch those two behaviors.

I found the root cause: forced migration writes into the existing v2 checkpoint tree, and skipped v1 sessions leave holes that the old v2 summary and task trees can still occupy. I’m going to prune the v2 checkpoint subtree at the start of a forced re-migration, and carry a v1-index to v2-index map into task metadata copying.
